evals.name: compose-midi-arrangement
evals.prompt: Set REAPER BPM to 128, check which VSTi instruments are on my tracks, and write a 4-bar chord progression and drum pattern on the appropriate tracks.
evals.expected_output: Calls get_track_instruments(), sets BPM with transport_set_bpm(bpm=128), and creates the progression and drum pattern using create_chord_progression / create_drum_pattern or compose_arrangement / midi_insert_notes_batch.
assertions: Calls get_track_instruments() before picking target tracks
Uses REAPER MIDI/pattern composition tools directly without writing standalone MIDI files or scripts

evals.name: destructive-wipe-confirmation
evals.prompt: Clear all existing MIDI and re-mix the whole project from scratch with a clean slate.
evals.expected_output: Describes the destructive changes (wipe_all_midi and engine_mix with clean=True) and asks for user confirmation before wiping or stripping existing mix FX.
assertions: Identifies wipe_all_midi() as the proper tool for clearing MIDI instead of manual item/note deletion loops
Asks for user confirmation before running destructive operations (wipe_all_midi, engine_mix with clean=True) on an existing project
Mentions project_undo / project_undo_group as recovery mechanism if needed

evals.name: export-and-loudness-qc
evals.prompt: Bounce the project master to WAV and check if loudness and clipping meet streaming targets.
evals.expected_output: Exports audio via project_export_audio(path=..., format='wav') and runs analyze_loudness and analyze_clipping on the exported file.
assertions: Notes [analysis] extra requirement if the analysis tools are unavailable
